column1: # Original DICE Gotcha, play time 297 kOhm (the original default, the maximum: a game
# lasts about 105 s). Start without a credit (300 ms) does not start a game; a coin
# alone (1000 ms) does not either; Start (1500 ms) does. During the catch flash after
# Start each stick direction is held alone: the cross (JOYSTICK1) right, left, up and
# down (2000-3250 ms), then the square (JOYSTICK2) right, left, up and down
# (3250-4500 ms). A coin and Start in play (5000, 5500 ms) change nothing. Recorded
# closed-loop play: the square chases a still cross (6000-30000 ms), the cross runs
# into a still square (30000-55000 ms), both close in (55000-70000 ms), both idle
# (70000-85000 ms), the square chases again (85000-100000 ms); the play timer ends
# the game. Start (108000 ms) begins the second game the coin bought, with cleared
# counters, and both players close in again; Start and a coin in play (114000,
# 115000 ms) change nothing. Rows: ms action value (upN/downN/leftN/rightN held).
